name: Plugin commands help
description: Help mode entries for the Plugin commands plugin (help@1): its page, its settings tab and its buttons.
author: Brett

entries.title: Plugin commands
entries.text: Every plugin's commands and reads, made automatically from each plugin's routes, actions, data folder and plugin.json. Claude reaches them through axHub as MCP tools, the REST API at /api/control/<plugin>/<command>, and the CLI axf <plugin> <command>. A new plugin shows up by itself.

entries.title: Try
entries.text: Opens a command: what it does, its REST route, MCP tool and CLI line, and a box to run it.

entries.title: Read / Run
entries.text: Runs the command with the JSON input above, as the console. One that deletes answers with a confirm token first; press again to send it.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads every plugin's commands again (they also update by themselves when a plugin is installed, removed, or turned on or off).

entries.title: Bring them in step now
entries.text: Rebuilds the MCP tools for plugins straight away instead of waiting for the 30-second check.

entries.title: MCP tools and last commands
entries.text: The two MCP switches (plugin tools at all, and one tool per command) and the last plugin commands that ran, who ran them and how they went.

entries.title: All
entries.text: Shows every command and read of every plugin.

entries.title: Reads
entries.text: Shows only what can be read: GET routes, data folders and plugin info. Reads never change anything.

entries.title: Commands
entries.text: Shows only commands: routes that change something and actions that run in your open console. One that deletes needs a confirm token.

entries.title: Plugin tools on the console's MCP
entries.text: On: Claude sees plugin tools on the console's MCP (and through axHub). Off: no plugin tools at all; the REST API and the CLI still work.

entries.title: One tool per command
entries.text: On: every command and read gets its own MCP tool named <plugin>_<command>. Off: only plugin_commands, plugin_read and plugin_run, which reach the same commands by path.
